reserveReview.rationale: Current-source re-measurement at 2026-08-20T14:09:05Z. Issuer docs and UsdtDepositManager source confirm dual routes: users lock USDT on Optimism or USDC on Base; each DepositManager supplies the deposit token into Aave V3 and mints JPYT. Latest public RPC reads at Optimism block 155818084 returned aOptUSDT (0x6ab707aca953edaefbc4fd23ba73294241490620).balanceOf(0x77c1e40f5e7bb19c34d81f986fb13fe655f23cd9) = 44,868.289538 USDT; Base block 50222799 returned aBasUSDC (0x4e65fe4dba92790696d040ac24aa414708f5c0ab).balanceOf(0x0eab9d66adb8527cd7c0e7e7c1782580431ec276) = 6,906.778074 USDC. Combined aToken reserves = 51,775.067612 USD, giving 86.660031% USDT and 13.339969% USDC. Matching latest totalDepositToken reads (40,544.289114 USDT / 6,059.527039 USDC) confirm the two routes; operator-claimable Aave surplus (getCurrentAaveProfit) is included in aToken balances and is not a separate reserve class. Residual unknowns: Aave utilization-driven withdrawal latency and legal custody terms beyond on-chain smart-contract custody.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: On-chain aToken balances of DePhaser DepositManager proxies plus issuer money-flow docs
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Legal segregation/bankruptcy-remoteness of Aave positions and instantaneous redeemable liquidity under high Aave utilization are not published as static legal terms; weights themselves are measured.
